entries.subject: ESO eso1129a (Very Large Telescope FORS1)
entries.finding: The inner disc in B, V and I, 2046 px across at 0.200 arcsec per pixel, CC BY 4.0. It covers 6.8 arcmin of a disc about 11 arcmin long.
entries.revisitWhen: A whole-disc photograph of comparable quality is published under an attribution licence.

entries.subject: Catalogues of NGC 3521's nebulae and clusters
entries.finding: Looked for on CDS on 2026-10-02: the PHANGS-MUSE nebula, planetary-nebula and supernova-remnant catalogues have no rows for NGC 3521. The bank has no dots.
entries.revisitWhen: A catalogue of its HII regions, clusters or remnants with sky positions is published.
